assets.author: Kenney
assets.changes: Derived from ship-large: sails/flags removed; clipped at Y=2.45; coplanar overlapping faces resolved by planar subtraction, retaining the first authored surface and interpolating attributes at new boundaries. Lower hull/deck silhouette, normal directions, UV field, palette and material retained. Native main deck Y=2.1.

assets.title: Giraffe
assets.author: Poly by Google
assets.changes: Original GLB retained. Runtime scale, orientation, placement and material roughness adapted for the museum.

assets.title: Gavel
assets.author: Poly by Google
assets.changes: Original geometry and material palette retained; sound block separated from the hammer by connected topology, hammer pivot added at its grip, scale/orientation/roughness adapted for the auction lectern.

assets.author: Kenney
assets.changes: Curated original GLB; uniform scale, placement and material roughness adapted for the auction theatre.

assets.title: Cannon mobile
assets.author: Kenney
assets.changes: Three authored meshes baked into one draw; all triangles, transformed normals and palette UVs preserved. Unused tangents removed. Rotated and scaled to the existing cannon floor and exact muzzle anchor. Original palette retained locally; runtime roughness normalized.

assets.title: Treasure chest
assets.author: Kenney
assets.changes: Original meshes, node hierarchy, hinged lid, open/close clips, normals, UVs, palette and binary retained. Only palette URI and generator metadata changed. Placement scale and roughness normalized at runtime.

assets.title: Telescope
assets.author: CreativeTrio
assets.changes: Original 734-triangle geometry and embedded palette retained. Placement, uniform scale, roughness and metalness normalized by the shared model loader. Fixed observational prop; no periodic animation or moving light.

assets.title: Collectible Gear
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.changes: Original mesh, normals, topology, material palette and binary retained. A new root aligns the dominant gear face to +Z, allowing an axial Z rotation. Uniform size and roughness normalized by the shared loader.

assets.title: Open Book
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.changes: Original geometry, materials, normals and binary retained. Placement, uniform scale and roughness normalized by the shared loader; used as a fixed open goal book and reading-desk prop. No navigation or scoring data is embedded in the decoration.

assets.name: spotlight
assets.title: Theater spotlight
assets.author: lakescorp
assets.changes: Original geometry, nodes, normals and embedded palette retained. Scale, placement, orientation and roughness normalized for the overhead rig. No extra real-time light is created.

assets.name: camera
assets.title: Movie / film camera on tripod
assets.author: Franziska Haaf
assets.changes: Original geometry, node transforms, normals and binary retained. The original white body and lens/tripod materials are recolored slate blue and charcoal, with matte roughness. Scale and orientation normalized at placement. Attribution and changes are also visible in the studio's Models & Artists disclosure.

assets.title: Erlenmeyer flask
assets.author: Poly by Google
assets.changes: Removed the floating turquoise bubble primitive; retained the flask and its graduation marks. Tinted opaque ceramic ivory and graphite, adjusted roughness, placed and scaled for the pigment laboratory. Original binary mesh data retained.

assets.title: Wrench
assets.author: Armory_3D
assets.changes: Added a root rotation to stand the long axis vertically and face the thin tool toward Z. Original geometry, UVs, normals and binary retained. Material recolored muted steel with reduced metalness and increased roughness; instances scaled and slightly tilted on toolboards.

assets.title: Gazebo
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.changes: Roof recolored muted terracotta and wood warm honey; roughness increased and metalness reduced. Original geometry, normals, UVs, node transforms and binary retained. Scaled and placed as the picnic garden's rear shelter.

assets.title: Low Poly Tree House
assets.author: Gilang Romadhan
assets.changes: Removed the earth base, grass and stone path for placement on a timber terrace. Retained the trunk house, door, porch, balcony and fixtures. Recolored cedar wood, cream trim and muted metal; retained active geometry, normals, UVs and node transform. Repacked only referenced accessors and buffer views, scaled and placed on the rear treehouse terrace.

assets.title: Art Easel Set Up
assets.author: reyshapes
assets.changes: Preserved positions, normals, authored node transforms and the vertex-painted palette. Combined ten material primitives into one opaque rough nonmetallic material; packed vertex colors as normalized unsigned bytes with at most 0.5/255 component error; removed unused UVs and FBX extras. Scaled and placed beside the idea-city workshop.

assets.title: Wall_ArchRound_Broken from Modular Ruins Pack
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.changes: Selected only Wall_ArchRound_Broken and its root transform. Removed all other kit objects, unused embedded images, UVs and buffer data. Preserved active positions, normals and indices; recolored two opaque stone materials to match the river ruins and set nonmetallic roughness. Scaled and placed behind the playable route.

assets.title: Tent
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.changes: Preserved the tent geometry and authored root transform. Removed unused UVs and FBX extras, repacked active binary data, adapted opaque canvas, wood and rope colors and nonmetallic roughness. Scaled and placed at the rear of the base camp.

assets.title: Compass
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.changes: Preserved all compass geometry, indices and authored transforms. Adapted opaque brass, dark face, red and cream material colors and roughness. Placed as static navigation equipment on the side workbench, independent of the hidden destination or panorama heading.
